scottsdale_ruling.classification: Inside phoenix-az, split into FIVE corridors by its own postal codes: old-town-scottsdale (CORE), central-scottsdale (CORE), paradise-valley (CORE), scottsdale-airpark-kierland (STRONG CORRIDOR) and north-scottsdale (STRONG CORRIDOR).
scottsdale_ruling.not_flattened_because: Scottsdale is a traveller identity of its own -- Old Town's arts, dining and nightlife, the resort and spa cluster, spring training, golf and the McDowell Sonoran Preserve -- distinct from downtown Phoenix's convention, sports and government demand. Each of its districts keeps its own corridor page.
scottsdale_ruling.not_a_separate_market_because: One airport (PHX) serves both cities, and Scottsdale's hotel geography does not stop at the city line: 'Scottsdale' is the postal city of Paradise Valley's resorts, of the Salt River community's Talking Stick hotels and the marketed name of the City of Phoenix's Kierland and Desert Ridge. A separate market would have to split one postal code (85254) and one resort cluster. The order also forbids creating it here.
scottsdale_ruling.central_scottsdale: CORE -- 85250 / 85256 / 85258 / 85259 (McCormick Ranch, Gainey Ranch, Talking Stick).
scottsdale_ruling.paradise_valley_resort_cluster: CORE -- 85253, its own town; the highest resort-residence exposure, so only exact public hotel premises are admitted.
scottsdale_ruling.kierland_and_airpark: STRONG CORRIDOR -- 85254 / 85260; 85254 is mostly the City of Phoenix and is covered whole.
scottsdale_ruling.fringe: None of Scottsdale is FRINGE. Cave Creek / Carefree to its north are a FRINGE corridor of their own.
scottsdale_ruling.named_optionality: Recorded as this market's first candidate for promotion to a standalone scottsdale-az market, which a founder can split on the record.

maricopa.ruling: ADMITTED, SPLIT. The contiguous Valley -- Phoenix, Scottsdale, Paradise Valley, Tempe, Mesa, Chandler, Gilbert, Glendale, Peoria, Surprise, Goodyear, Avondale, Litchfield Park, Buckeye, Tolleson, Fountain Hills, Cave Creek, Carefree, Queen Creek and the Salt River / Fort McDowell / Gila River resort lands inside the metro -- is admitted; Wickenburg, Gila Bend, Tonopah and the western desert are REFUSED by name. County inclusion is not traveller-market inclusion.

pinal.ruling: ADMITTED ONLY AT THE EAST VALLEY EDGE. Apache Junction / Gold Canyon and Queen Creek's Pinal side are contiguous with Mesa and admitted at FRINGE; Casa Grande, the City of Maricopa, Florence, Eloy, Coolidge, San Tan Valley and Superior are refused.

yavapai / coconino / pima / gila / mohav.ruling: REFUSED. Sedona, Flagstaff, the Grand Canyon, Prescott and Tucson are separate markets, named FUTURE_STANDALONE; Payson, Lake Havasu, Kingman and Bullhead City are refused by name and prefix. Phoenix does not absorb Arizona.

fees.rule: a fee publishes only as one amount whose basis (per night / per stay) the quote itself states, with no stay-length condition, no range, no second basis and no second amount; otherwise the fee is withheld and the acceptance, weight, count and species still publish
